items.name: prepareColdPairFixtures
items.doc: Reads the corpus, derives the exact pack and spr pattern, rewrites the guest descriptor and builds the recorded traffic arrays.

items.name: openColdPairSession
items.doc: Installs the session capability and the fetch stub, opens the artifact, mints the lease and wires the fake socket and worker sink.

items.name: createColdPairWorkerClass
items.doc: Declares the fake browser actor worker class over the recorded traffic.

items.name: runColdPairActivationPhase
items.doc: Activates the reservation, installs the verified cold pair and asserts the exact page receipts and lazy render events.

items.name: runViewRefreshAndEarlyCommandPhase
items.doc: Refreshes the host view, offers a ui intent action and queues an early command behind the held patch.

items.name: runActionPatchAndDirectCommandPhase
items.doc: Applies the held action patch, answers the early command and runs the direct action and command invocations.

items.name: runApprovalUndoOwnerPhase
items.doc: Rebinds the approval undo owner across rebootstrap, share lease rotation and an in-flight undo.

items.name: runHostileRenderPhase
items.doc: Rejects hostile browser render rows and closes the render driver child.
